original_bug_description: A global-buffer-overflow in m3_compile.c: Compile_BlockStatements (opcode decoding) causes an out-of-bounds read from the global opcode table c_operationsFC. While compiling/parsing block expressions (seen via Parse_InitExpr / ParseSection_Data), an opcode index can exceed the c_operationsFC bounds and read 8 bytes past the array, leading to crashes or disclosure of adjacent memory.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=4968947125452800: wasm3 has a reported memory-safety bug. A global-buffer-overflow in m3_compile.c: Compile_BlockStatements (opcode decoding) causes an out-of-bounds read from the global opcode table c_operationsFC. While compiling/parsing block expressions (seen via Parse_InitExpr / ParseSection_Data), an opcode index can exceed the c_operationsFC bounds and read 8 bytes past the array, leading to crashes or disclosure of adjacent memory.
